mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals increased demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 2 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production shortfalls and reduced earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3pp in the same month, the combined signal of strong labor market conditions leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) increasing by more than 1% over the past quarter signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies benefit from increased revenues.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% over a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, the combined signal of strong supply-side growth and accommodative monetary policy leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with supply growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% and FEDFUNDS is below 2%.
